activity.notes: Pierre de Fermat (c.1607–1665) conducted mathematical investigations while employed as a French magistrate at Toulouse. A 1640 correspondence with Bernard Frénicle de Bessy states the result later known as Fermat's little theorem. This is a representative mathematical research/communication milestone in 1640, not an assertion that Fermat served as a royal mathematician or proved Fermat's Last Theorem. His historical legal office is separate from the representative science Activity. France is the canonical ATLAS historical polity; Kingdom of France is a period designation, not a new polity identity.
